material.description: Facts (origin/main b62d476): rust/crates/server has zero ModHost uses; rust/crates/mod-host/src/lib.rs:851 version() is never read by the server; no event route in rust/crates/server/src/lib.rs:202-208; rust/crates/web/site/main.js:55 fetches map.bin once with no listener. Needed: a server-side ModHost swap at the tick boundary, a versioned event route, and one main.js listener. That is a feature row, not one route and one listener; owner decision on hosting ModHost in the server.
material.resolution: The server hosts a ModHost on its own thread from --mod (requires --data). Each tick the mod thread runs reload then advance and publishes version through atomics; GET /mod-version and GET /mod-events expose the version, and the CI job checks a rise from 1 to 2 after an edit with the next tick logging the new value. Deviation: reload compile runs on the mod thread between ticks, not off the tick path, because ModHost is not Send; HTTP reads atomics only so a slow reload delays mod ticks, not HTTP.
material.subject: Server never hosts ModHost, so no mod swap event exists for clients (gap-client-hmr-update)
